status.en: 6 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 68% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Aleppo.
status.nb: 6 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 68 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Aleppo.

summary.en: Syrian forces are considering deploying troops to support Saudi Arabia against the Houthis while denying any presence in Yemen. Unidentified gunmen killed one Syrian soldier and wounded two in eastern Deir ez-Zor, with similar attacks reported in Jadidat Bakara. Lebanon has asked Syria to extradite suspects linked to the killing of an ex-Iraqi MP. Syrian security officials are restructuring the army and preparing new security and administrative changes. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske styrker vurderer å sette inn tropper for å støtte Saudi-Arabia mot houthiene, samtidig som de benekter enhver tilstedeværelse i Jemen. Uidentifiserte væpnede menn drepte en syrisk soldat og såret to i Øst-Deir ez-Zor, med lignende angrep rapportert i Jadidat Bakara. Libanon har bedt Syria om å utlevere mistenkte knyttet til drapet på en tidligere irakisk stortingsrepresentant. Syriske sikkerhetsmyndigheter omorganiserer hæren og forbereder nye sikkerhets‑ og administrative endringer. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
